summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares under Article 64 of Argentina’s Capital Markets Law, reported to the CNV, BYMA and MAE. On 10/09/2026, CPSA bought 120,000 shares on BYMA at an average AR$2,037.49, totaling AR$244,499,775; wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. bought 30,000 ADRs on NYSE at USD12.69, totaling USD380,764.92, each ADR representing ten shares. Purchases stayed below 25% of prior 90-day average daily volume. This is a routine buyback disclosure, with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, close date or change of control.
